tool_review.module_note: One owning module for all five exposed tools (single source tutorial). Tutorial id 'bulk_rna' disambiguates from docs/notebooks/bench/rna.ipynb.

user_input_contract.counts: Raw integer counts (samples x genes AnnData .h5ad with obs, or a counts table plus a sample-metadata table). Orientation must be resolved by matching sample IDs to the metadata index and failing clearly on mismatch; no silent transposition guessing beyond that check.
user_input_contract.gene_identifiers: Gene symbols matching CollecTRI/PROGENy/Hallmark targets (HGNC for human). Duplicate gene names must fail clearly (dc.pp.extract asserts unique features). Ensembl->symbol conversion is outside the filtered tutorial (e.g. GEO GSE52778 airway counts are Ensembl-keyed and need user-side mapping).
user_input_contract.metadata: Sample metadata with a condition column; the column name and the two group labels are parameters (condition_key, group, reference). Tutorial values condition/treatment/control come from dc.ds.hsctgfb's loader, which derives them from sample names; that construction belongs to test fixture preparation only.
user_input_contract.example_new_data: GSE52778 airway: condition_key='dex', group='trt', reference='untrt', design='~cell + dex' (labels as in the user's metadata).

task_and_io.outputs: filtered counts (h5ad keeping obs) for downstream DE; kept-gene list/count; threshold diagnostic PNG (log10 total counts vs number of samples with dashed cutoffs).

task_and_io.outputs: results table indexed by gene: baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj (CSV); volcano PNG (x=log2FoldChange, y=padj, top=10).

task_and_io.outputs: full scores and BH-adjusted p-values for all sources (long table: source, score, padj, significant); significance-filtered subset; barplot PNG; dotplot PNG (score vs source, size -log10 padj clipped at 2.22e-16); network snapshot size (rows) for provenance.

blockers_and_risks: Network access at runtime and in tests: CollecTRI from zenodo.org (records/8192729), PROGENy via omnipathdb.org (resource() first calls show_resources() which hits omnipathdb.org/queries/annotations and /resources), Hallmark from static.omnipathdb.org, hsctgfb from NCBI GEO. Recommend a per-process network cache and saving downloaded network snapshots as test fixtures.

Remote resource drift: tutorial outputs reflect network versions at its execution time (CollecTRI 42990, PROGENy 62421, Hallmark 7318 rows). Exact score comparisons need the same snapshot; compare against stage-2 re-execution and treat the notebook's stored values as tolerance-based spot checks, recording row counts.
PyDESeq2 is unpinned by decoupler; env currently resolves 0.5.4. Tutorial-stored DE values may differ slightly across versions; record the version and compare with tolerance.

igraph (optional dependency, decoupler[full]) is required by dc.pl.network (src/decoupler/_odeps.py raises ImportError otherwise); it is absent from reports/environment-requirements.txt (pydeseq2 0.5.4 and scanpy 1.12.4 are present). Either install igraph or defer only the network-plot output of decoupler_inspect_source_targets.
scanpy (decoupler[full]/test) required for the PCA tool; PC signs can differ across versions, so compare sign-invariant statistics.
Randomness: none material. dc.pp.extract shuffles features with fixed seed 0 for tie-breaking; ulm, filter_by_expr and PyDESeq2 are deterministic; scanpy PCA uses random_state=0.

Input contract risks: ulm asserts on non-finite values in the stat vector; filter_by_expr/extract assert on duplicate gene names; PyDESeq2 requires non-negative integer counts. Wrappers should surface these as clear input errors rather than silently repairing.
